results.content: During the engagement of the independent advisor, entities may look to assess the effectiveness of their output and ability to help inform the management of risk through the following processes:. | * Concentrate on high risks * Identify existing/available metrics * Understand the frequency of data availability * Determine if there are data gaps or metric improvements | * Focus on indicators that may track changes in the risk profile * Leading indicators will provide a more predictive and informative * A mix of leading and lagging indicators will provide better risk management * Determine trigger levels and thresholds, without contradiction to risk appetite | * Determine frequency of tracking * Escalation and reporting framework should be in place * KRI reports should indicate trends and movements in risk * A dashboard format is often he easiest wat to track and report KRIs | * Action plans should be created where KRIs are trending toward highest threshold * Target completion dates for actions should be set and included in reporting |.
